children.name: Comamonas testosteroni
children.description: Comamonas testosteroni is a Gram-negative environmental bacterium capable of utilizing testosterone as a carbon source, and degrading other sterols such as ergosterol and estrogens.

children.name: Ottowia thiooxydans
children.description: Ottowia thiooxydans is a Gram-staining, facultatively anaerobic, N2O-producing and non-motile bacterium from the genus Ottowia which has been isolated from activated sludge from Munich in Germany.

children.name: Sphaerotilus natans
children.description: Sphaerotilus natans is an aquatic periphyton bacterial organism associated with polluted water.

children.name: Brachymonas denitrificans
children.description: Brachymonas denitrificans is a nonmotile, Gram-negative, aerobic, chemo-organotrophic bacterium from the genus Brachymonas and family Comamonadaceae.

children.name: Aquabacterium olei
children.description: Aquabacterium olei is a Gram-negative, non-spore-forming and motile bacterium of the genus Aquabacterium which has been isolated from oil-contaminated soil in Korea.

children.name: Aquabacterium fontiphilum
children.description: Aquabacterium fontiphilum is a Gram-negative non-spore-forming, motile bacterium of the genus Aquabacterium in the family Comamonadaceae, which was isolated from a water sample from the Nature Valley in Hsinchu County in Taiwan.
